d: In this video, we explore the complete story behind the CJP (Cockroach Janta Party) protest and how an online youth movement transformed into one of India's most talked-about public campaigns. From its origins on social media to the demonstrations at Jantar Mantar, we examine the timeline, key events, major demands, and the people who became closely associated with the movement, including Sonam Wangchuk and Abhijeet Dipke.
